name: Target: Dalson's Tears
label: Quest
description: Target: Dalson's Tears: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: One of the plague cauldrons is located in the field of a former farmhouse now referred to as Dalson's Tears. No tears will be shed this day, adventurer; we must strike at this cauldron and gain access to it!

Go to Dalson's Tears, almost due north of Andorhal, and eliminate the cauldron lord there. It should have a key like the last one did, allowing you inside the cauldron's innards. Use this bottle to obtain a sample from inside the cauldron; each cauldron has its own distinct brew of toxins it uses.

clips.title: Progress
paras: An access panel to the cauldron remains securely fastened. In order to open it, you will need to find the key.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The skeletal key found on the cauldron lord easily slides into a keyhole and then disappears, allowing you permanent access to it. Crude, viscous ichors pulsate through twisted tubes within the cauldrons underpinnings.
There is a small spigot that the bottle fits well enough under, allowing you to draw a sample for Shadow Priestess Vandis back at the Bulwark.
